Free high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout all rooms, villas, and public areas of the resort. If you need assistance connecting, please dial 0 from your room phone to reach the front desk 24/7.

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, kiến trúc Đông Dương (Indochine), gồm phòng khách sạn và biệt thự, có bãi biển riêng và hồ bơi nước ngọt lớn nhất khu vực. About Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. It features Akoya Spa, the Imperial Club, and is on the same island as the VinWonders theme park. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

reference_contexts: Không đúng, nhà hàng Lotus đóng cửa lúc 22:00.
actual_answer:
ロタスレストランの営業時間は午前6時から午後10時30分、正午から午後2時30分、そして午後6時から午後10時までです。  
深夜3時は営業しておりません。  
詳細は電話で確認できますので、お気軽にご連絡ください。

A hotel room holds a maximum of 4 people including children under 4, as 3 adults + 1 child or 2 adults + 2 children, with at most one extra bed. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. question: 屋外プールは夜通し開いていますよね?
ground_truth: Không đúng, hồ bơi đóng cửa lúc 20:00.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, hồ bơi đóng cửa lúc 20:00.
actual_answer:
屋外プールは06:00から20:00までしか開いていません。  
19:00以降には救護員が不在のため、海での入浴は禁止されています。  
夜間の静寂時間は22:00から始まり、テレビ音量は10以下に抑える必要があります。

passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

question: 持ち込んだ生の海鮮を厨房で無料で調理してもらえますか?
ground_truth: Không đúng, nhà hàng không nhận chế biến đồ ăn mang ngoài vào và có tính phí dịch vụ.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, nhà hàng không nhận chế biến đồ ăn mang ngoài vào và có tính phí dịch vụ.
actual_answer: 生鮮海産物を厨房で無料調理することはできません。ビラ厨房は加熱のみが許可されており、BBQ や調理には登録と手数料が必要です。また、外から持ち込む食材にはサービス料 1,175,000 VND が課されます。

Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. Bringing food or drink in from outside must be declared and carries a service fee of 1,175,000 VND per occasion, with a liability waiver to sign. Durian, jackfruit and other strongly scented food may not be taken into the rooms, and weapons, chemicals and explosives are prohibited. A villa kitchen is for reheating only; a barbecue must be registered with the Customer Service Centre and a fee applies. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. ground_truth: Không đúng, khách sạn không có dịch vụ mượn ô tô tự lái miễn phí.

actual_answer:
ホテルでは、自走式車両を無料でお貸しするサービスはありません。

Resort hotline +84 258 359 8222; restaurant reservations and bookings 0258 359 8900. The address is Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang City, Khanh Hoa. Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.content:

Tiện ích cho người khuyết tật
Resort có lối đi cho xe lăn trong khuôn viên và thang máy tại các khu phòng nghỉ. Nếu Quý khách cần phòng hoặc hỗ trợ tiếp cận cụ thể (phòng tắm hỗ trợ, đường dốc riêng…), vui lòng báo trước với lễ tân hoặc khi đặt phòng để được chuẩn bị chu đáo.

Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.content:

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.content:

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

question: 閑散期は宿泊者リストを何日前に送る必要がありますか?
ground_truth: 7 ngày
reference_contexts: 7 ngày
actual_answer:
閑散期には、宿泊者リストを到着から7日前に送る必要があります。
高シーズンやピークシーズン・春節期間の場合は、それぞれ15日前または予約時点で送る必要があります。
詳細な期限は季節と時期によって異なりますので、ご確認いただくことをお勧めします。

complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. passages.title: Check-in deposit
passages.content:
Check-in deposit
deposit, guarantee, refund, checkin, villa, damage
A deposit is collected at check-in: 1,000,000 VND per room and 3,000,000 VND per villa. It is returned in full at check-out provided there are no unpaid charges and nothing in the room has been damaged or is missing. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Thời gian hoàn tiền (tiếng Việt): Tiền đặt cọc được hoàn ĐẦY ĐỦ NGAY tại thời điểm trả phòng (check-out) nếu không phát sinh chi phí chưa thanh toán và không có hư hỏng/mất mát — không phải chờ ngày làm việc. Với các khoản hoàn tiền khác (ví dụ hoàn tiền do lỗi giao dịch/kỹ thuật hoặc theo chính sách hủy), thời gian xử lý tối đa là 45 ngày làm việc.

passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 技術的・取引上のエラーによる返金の場合、どれくらいかかりますか?
ground_truth: A refund for a transaction/technical error or per cancellation policy takes up to 45 working days to process — this is different from the check-in deposit, which is returned immediately at check-out. 技術的または取引上のエラーにより処理が拒否された場合、最大45営業日以内に返金されます。

Biệt thự Tropicana 3 phòng ngủ, hướng biển (Tropicana Beachfront Villa 3-Bedroom) Diện tích 370 m². 3 phòng ngủ. Hướng biển. Có hồ bơi riêng. Tối đa 12 khách (6 người lớn + 6 trẻ em hoặc 12 người lớn + 0 trẻ em). Biệt thự 2 tầng 3 phòng ngủ và diện tích 370m2 được trang bị đầy đủ nội thất hiện đại, giường êm ái và ghế sofa mềm mại, hứa hẹn một kỳ nghỉ thư thái không đâu có được. Sở hữu khuôn viên rợp bóng cây nhiệt đới, bể bơi riêng cùng con đường dẫn ra biển xanh trong vắt, biệt thự rất phù hợp cho các gia đình, nhóm bạn hoặc khách doanh nhân muốn tận hưởng và tái tạo năng lượng trong một ốc đảo bình yên.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. question: 予約番号VPNT-8N55VCの宿泊者リストの変更を送ってください — グループの1名を変更したいです。
ground_truth: Per KB #18, the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season/Tet; changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change (waived on proof of illness or natural disaster). The agent must ask which window applies or state the fee, not silently accept the change with no condition.
actual_answer:
予約番号 VPNT-8N55VC の宿泊者リスト変更は、グループが 10 室以上または 5 ヴィラ以上である場合のみ可能であり、その条件に該当するか確認が必要です。また、変更期限の 7 日（低シーズン）、15 日（高シーズン）、または予約時（ピークシーズン・テト）までに送付されているかを確認する必要があります。該当する場合は、変更後の宿泊者情報および費用について詳細をご提示いたします。

question: 会社で10月8日から10日までデラックスクイーンの部屋を5室予約しますが、部屋代の合計はいくらですか?
ground_truth: Deluxe Queen is from 2,200,000 VND per night; 5 rooms for 2 nights totals 22,000,000 VND (5 x 2,200,000 x 2), and 5 rooms is still an individual booking (Khach Le goes up to 9 rooms per night), not a group rate. The agent must give the per-night rate and should not apply a group discount that does not exist at this size.
actual_answer:
会社の予約（10室以上）は団体予約となり、公式料金の最安パッケージ「Deluxe Giường Đôi」の価格に基づき計算します。  
各泊まりあたり3,580,000 VNDが最安パッケージの価格であり、合計は3,580,000 VND × 5泊 = 17,900,000 VNDとなります。  
ただし、これは公式料金の最安パッケージのみであり、より高価なパッケージや特典が含まれるプランが存在する可能性があります。

question: クリスマスに15室予約しますが、団体割引はありますか?
ground_truth: The corpus states 10+ rooms is classified as a group booking (Khach Le individual bookings stop at 9), but gives no specific group discount percentage or holiday rate. The agent must say the booking is classified as a group and hand off for a quote, not invent a discount figure.
actual_answer:
15室の予約は、10室以上となるため団体予約（グループ予約）となります。

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 2026年6月15日にチェックインして2泊予約してください。
ground_truth: 15/06/2026 has already passed relative to today. The agent must flag the past date and ask for a corrected one instead of proceeding as if it were a future booking.
actual_answer:
2026年6月15日のチェックインは、標準的なチェックアウト時間である午後12時より前であるため、早期チェックインの条件を満たしません。  
早めのチェックインを希望される場合は、事前に確認が必要であり、06:00以降の到着にはパッケージ価格の50％が課されます。  
また、2泊の予約は通常可能ですが、パッケージ代金は登録された滞在期間全体に対して支払われる必要があります。

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for.
